'''Citypath 515''' was a transit route located in [[Cityblock Kesk-319]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]<ref name="Raid" /> as of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Orbit Date" /> A [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]], the [[Pathline Tapcafe]], was located at the intersection of [[Route 6903]], another roadway, and Citypath 515. Citypath 515 was wide and active, like all streets in [[Kesk Cityblock]], but was seldom used by people on foot and privately owned vehicles.<ref name="Raid" />

==Behind the scenes==
Citypath 515 was first mentioned in ''[[Raid on Brentaal]]'', an adventure scenario in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and had the same theme of the previous publication ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', as it followed the [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'' in its adventures.<ref name="Raid" />
